verdict.rationale: Gecko's v1 API lets developers read scan, repository, and vulnerability data programmatically (implying JSON responses) and an OpenAPI spec is published, but there is no explicit documentation of a SARIF export format or dedicated 'JSON report' output for CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit SARIF format support, documented JSON report export command, and any CI-integration example showing machine-readable output being consumed downstream.
